protocol.json.purpose: Timing variability diagnosis on adopted baseline only, no candidate timing or adoption.
protocol.json.source: same ROT kernel and fixed1280000000 iterations from previous baseline-only6sec pilot; no choosing a new N after observing candidate.
protocol.json.runs: two alternating independent A/A series; warmup1 excluded,5 samples each A1/A2; preserve all samples.
protocol.json.metrics: Separate process kernel/user time and raw QueryProcessCycleTime snapshots at existing clock-read boundaries. PID+UTC+perf_counter for correlation; no semantic claims about hardware frequency from cycle ratios. API errors recorded without escalation.
protocol.json.monitoring: Concurrent Processor Information logical0 counter logging1Hz, maximum150 samples. Monitoring overhead explicit; this diagnostic run is not an adoption benchmark.
protocol.json.policy: No OS/power/affinity changes other than pinning own runner/children CPU0 as before. No new thresholds, no retroactive sample exclusions or changed primary metric.

scripts.run.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys,datetime,hashlib
out=Path('.work/vm-time-audit-20261116').resolve();rows=[]
for index in (1,2):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(out/'worker.py'),'aa','rot','--series',str(index)]
 with (out/f'run-{index}.log').open('wb') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 rows.append({'command':cmd,'exit':r.returncode});(out/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');assert r.returncode==0
 value=json.loads((out/f'rot-aa-{index}.json').read_text());print('audit series',index,'CPU delta',value['aa_delta_percent'],flush=True)
(out/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'series':2,'primary_metric_or_OS_policy_changed':False},indent=2)+'\n')

limitations: Monitoring overhead included; no retrospective diagnosis of the earlier candidate outlier; raw process cycle values not interpreted as retired instructions or clock frequency. Median(kernel)+median(user) need not equal median(total).
